real: A U.S. amateur hockey team beats the Soviet Union — the team that had never lost
source: 1980 — the 'Miracle on Ice': the U.S. Olympic hockey team, made of amateurs and college players, upset the heavily-favored Soviet Union 4-3 in Lake Placid, the night before the gold-medal game.

real: A pitcher retires all 27 batters in a game — a feat almost never done
source: In baseball, a perfect game is the rarest of feats: a pitcher retires all 27 opposing batters with no hits, walks, or errors. Only a handful have ever been thrown in the modern era.

real: A retired champion comes out of retirement to beat the heavyweight in the jungle
source: 1974 — the 'Rumble in the Jungle': George Foreman, the heavyweight champion, was knocked out in the eighth round by Muhammad Ali in Kinshasa, Zaire, one of the greatest comebacks in boxing history.

real: Two legends fight 14 brutal rounds in the heat — and the champ nearly doesn't survive

real: A track star wins four golds in Nazi Berlin — right in Hitler's face
